findings.evidence: Previous round live diagnostic: the 1,063,236-byte original WebP took 9.09 seconds to download; the viewer emitted open but no opened event while waiting, and deferred its transform and close handling.

At 200% root text size, the first SuperMimic code block changed from fitting to horizontally overflowing while tabindex remained absent. ResizeObserver, disclosure toggles and font completion now schedule batched measurements. The existing asynchronous copy focus behavior passed without changing it.

findings.status: fixed; delayed-frame regression, 12 search layouts and 165 accessibility layouts passed
findings.evidence: A controlled delayed requestAnimationFrame on open deterministically moved focus from an already chosen search result back to the input. Opening now focuses/selects synchronously; no deferred callback can reclaim focus.
